propositions: transport.py has grown to 799/800 LOC and blocks landing of parent-related changes due to module-size cap
Previous reactive splits (retry.py, transitions.py) did not provide new operations an obvious home, causing code to re-accumulate in transport.py
The natural module boundaries exist but are not used: _backend.py already defines capability Protocols that should organize file structure
A capability-driven split into mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people, _properties, _comments) will reduce transport.py to 230 LOC with all modules in the 100–500 target band
The split must be mechanical relocation preserving class identity, Protocol conformance, facade re-exports, and test behavior unmodified
Epic-link field resolution logic must have exactly one definition after the split to avoid reintroducing duplication from commit 9bb9
